issues.on_page: Inheritance Fund column Other 1,429,625; Statement of Activities p2 Inheritance 1,429,625

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities p2: fees and charges for services 3,142,175 (general government 2,569,585, public safety 543,044)

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities p2: Public health, Operating Grants and Contributions 3,661,382
issues.issue: The report classifies this exact amount as operating grants and contributions (probably employee health premium contributions). It could be donations/contributions rather than other.
The printed label is 'Local'. The category comes only from the amount matching Statement of Activities 'Sale of surplus property' 38,795 (p2). This is defensible but inferred.
